title: CosmicDAO
description: This DAO is made just for fun and educational purposes only. It is a community for space enthusiasts. Anyone can become a member by claiming a free NFT known as "Cosmic Pass". After someone become a member, they can create or vote on proposals from the dashboard using. The governance token is airdropped to the early members of the DAO.
how_its_made:
This project is made with nodejs and react. It uses thirdweb sdk for blockchain integration. The scripts used to build/deploy the smart contract are present in the scripts folder.
